patients.summary: Former smoker with hypertension and hyperlipidemia who joined in 2022 doing yearly FIT; a 2025 risk conversation led to colonoscopy and a stage III ascending colon adenocarcinoma, resected and treated with adjuvant CAPOX, complicated in January 2026 by clindamycin-associated diarrhea seen by GI after her last practice visit.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller wants to transfer her care here; her old office is no longer taking her plan's preferred-provider tier. Works in a high school front office, flexible in summer. Takes two daily BP/cholesterol pills. Booked new-patient visit 6/21 at 9:00. Asked her to sign the release so we can pull records from the prior office; form emailed.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, new patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
55F transferring care. Here to get set up and keep her two regular meds going.

HTN: on amlodipine 5 mg for several years via her old office. No home cuff. No headaches, no palpitations, no ankle swelling.
Lipids: atorvastatin 20 mg, tolerates it fine, no muscle aches.
Takes acetaminophen 500 mg now and then for ordinary aches; no NSAIDs.

PSH: appendectomy at 16, gallbladder out at 42.
Allergies: PENICILLIN - anaphylaxis (as a young adult, needed epinephrine). IV CONTRAST - hives with a CT years ago.
FH: father had colon cancer at 67; his father also had colon cancer. Mother has osteoporosis.
SH: high school administrative assistant. Smoked ~15 pack-years, quit 2017. Wine 2-3 glasses a month. Married.

Screening: Pap/HPV done 2021 at old office, normal per pt. Mammogram 2021. Has been doing the stool kit (FIT) yearly; had a long talk with her old doctor about colonoscopy and prefers the kit for now. Discussed again given dad and grandfather; she knows colonoscopy is the stronger test, wants to keep FIT this year. Will send kit.

Exam: well, pleasant. BP as recorded. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abdomen soft, nontender, healed RLQ and laparoscopic scars. No peripheral edema.

A/P
1. HTN - at goal, continue amlodipine 5.
2. Hyperlipidemia - continue atorvastatin 20; fasting lipids, CMP, CBC today. A1c once.
3. Screening - HCV and HIV once today. FIT kit. Screening mammogram order. Old records requested.
4. Former smoker, 15 pk-yr - below the pack-year threshold for lung CT screening.
RTC 6 months.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Patricia, your blood work looks good. Kidney and liver tests normal, blood counts normal, A1c in the normal range, hepatitis C and HIV screens negative. LDL is right around 100 on the atorvastatin, which is fine for you. No changes. The stool kit should come in the mail within the week.

reports.text: Specimen: liquid-based cervical cytology with high-risk HPV co-test. Satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV not detected.
Bilateral CC and MLO views. Scattered areas of fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, calcification or architectural distortion. Prior films not available.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Records from her previous internal medicine office arrived, 38 pages, covering 2016-2022. Contents: office notes for blood pressure and cholesterol on amlodipine 5 and atorvastatin 20; Pap with HPV co-test 5/2021 negative; screening mammogram 11/2021 negative; FIT 2021 negative; Tdap 4/2019. Allergy page lists penicillin (anaphylaxis) and iodinated contrast (hives). Imported to chart; flagged for PCP.

documents.title: Stool test result
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Your stool screening test (FIT) was negative. We will send a new kit next summer. Please call if you notice blood in your stool or a change in bowel habits before then.

documents.title: Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came after school. Screened, no fever or illness today. Penicillin/contrast allergies noted, no vaccine reactions in the past. Flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid; Pfizer bivalent booster IM right deltoid. Observed 15 min, fine. VIS provided.

reports.text: Bilateral CC and MLO tomosynthesis views compared with 11/2021. Scattered fibroglandular densities. No mass, suspicious calcifications or distortion. Skin and nipples unremarkable.

documents.title: Mammogram result
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Your screening mammogram on 11/17 was normal. Next one is due in a year.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
6-mo f/u. Feels fine, busy stretch at work before the break. Taking amlodipine and atorvastatin every morning, no missed doses she knows of. No dizziness, no swelling.
Exam: BP as charted, at goal. RRR. Lungs clear. No edema.
FIT 7/22 negative, mammo 11/22 negative, flu and COVID booster done 10/22.
Plan: same meds, 90-day supplies sent. Physical in June with labs.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pharmacy fax for amlodipine 5 mg and atorvastatin 20 mg, 90 days each. Last seen 12/13/22, BP at goal. Approved per protocol with 1 refill each.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical, 56F. School year just wrapped. No complaints. Walks most evenings.
ROS: no chest discomfort, no breathlessness, no change in bowel habit, no blood in stool, no weight change, no urinary symptoms. Postmenopausal, no bleeding.
Meds: amlodipine 5, atorvastatin 20, acetaminophen prn. Allergies: penicillin (anaphylaxis), contrast (hives).
Exam: BP as charted. HEENT normal. Thyroid not enlarged. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts deferred to mammo. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. Skin without suspicious lesions. No edema.
PHQ-2 0.
Prevention: Pap/HPV 2021 negative, next 2026. Mammo 11/22 neg, ordering this year's. FIT again this summer; re-offered colonoscopy given her father and grandfather, she prefers the kit again. Shingrix #1 today, #2 in 2-6 mo.
Plan: CMP, CBC, lipids today. Continue meds.

documents.title: Lab results from your physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Everything from Wednesday is back and normal, cholesterol about where it was last year. Keep doing what you're doing. Your arm may stay a bit sore from the shingles shot for a day or two.

documents.title: Stool test result
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Good news, your FIT came back negative. Next kit will go out in summer 2024.

documents.title: Shingrix #2
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Second Shingrix, IM left deltoid. After dose 1 she had a tired evening and a sore arm, nothing more. Series complete. Reminded flu/COVID clinic opens in October.

documents.title: Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu (L deltoid) and 2023-24 COVID (R deltoid). Feeling well today. Waited 15 minutes, no reaction.

reports.text: Bilateral tomosynthesis screening views, compared with 2021 and 2022. Scattered fibroglandular tissue. No new mass, suspicious calcification or asymmetry.

documents.title: Mammogram result
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Your mammogram from 11/28 is normal. See you for your next one in about a year.
